name: Adirate
source:
Game consists of four short stories.

1. A schoolgirl undergoes trials to enter the limited membership club
2. You must help 7 girls trapped in the labyrinth
3. Two young people with amnesia try to escape a mysterious hospital
4. Deceptively young looking girl gets caught and accused of witchcraft.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
